title: Filter
description: Filter the dataframe based on the contents. If multiple filters are specified, all must be correct. For complex filters, use the where parameter.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Name of the column to filter on. If multiple are provided, all must match the criteria.

parameters.name: equal
parameters.description: Select rows where the values equal a given value.

parameters.name: not_equal
parameters.description: Select rows where the values do not equal a given value.

parameters.name: is_in
parameters.description: Select rows where the values are in a given list.

parameters.name: not_in
parameters.description: Select rows where the values are not in a given list.

parameters.name: greater_than
parameters.description: Select rows where the values are greater than a specified value. Does include the value itself.

parameters.name: greater_than_equal_to
parameters.description: Select rows where the values are greater than a specified value. Does include the value itself.

parameters.name: less_than
parameters.description: Select rows where the values are less than a specified value. Does not include the value itself.

parameters.name: less_than_equal_to
parameters.description: Select rows where the values are less than a specified value. Does include the value itself.

parameters.name: between
parameters.description: Value or list of values to filter that are in between two parameter values.

parameters.name: contains
parameters.description: Select rows where the input contains the value. Allows regular expressions.

parameters.name: not_contains
parameters.description: Select rows where the input does not contain the value. Allows regular expressions.

parameters.name: is_null
parameters.description: If true, select all rows where the value is NULL. If false, where is not NULL.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Filter the dataframe based on the contents. ## Migrated examples #### Filtering a Column ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: # Select only red fruits - filter: input: Color equal: - red ```
##### Input Sample | Color | Fruit | | --- | --- | | red | Apple | | green | Apple | | orange | Orange | | red | Strawberry |
##### Output Sample | Color | Fruit | | --- | --- | | red | Apple | | red | Strawberry |
